summary:
GE航太EPS大超預期16%，營收年增近25%顯示商用航空引擎與售後服務需求爆發。
• EPS 1.86美元，大幅超越預期1.60美元，超預期幅度16.31%
• 營收123.9億美元，年增24.74%，反映航空旅運與引擎售後需求強勁
• 高利潤的售後服務（aftermarket）為獲利大幅超預期的關鍵
• 聚焦純航太業務後，營運效率與訂單能見度提升
ai_view:
訊號強勁：16%的EPS超預期搭配近25%營收年增，顯示商用航空引擎與高利潤售後服務需求旺盛，純航太轉型後獲利品質提升。短期股價有強支撑，惟42倍本益比對應高預期。中期關注引擎交付能否跟上需求、售後服務利潤率與訂單積壓。追蹤指標：商用引擎出貨與售後營收、營業利潤率、自由現金流、訂單積壓與全年指引。

需留意：本益比42.82倍偏高，估值已反映航太景氣樂觀；供應鏈與零件交付瓶頸可能限制產量；航空旅運需求對總體經濟與地緣政治敏感

summary_en:
GE Aerospace crushed EPS by 16% with ~25% revenue growth on booming commercial engine and aftermarket demand.
• EPS of $1.86 sharply beat the $1.60 estimate by 16.31%
• Revenue of $12.39B grew 24.74%, driven by strong air travel and engine-aftermarket demand
• High-margin aftermarket services were key to the large earnings beat
• Post-spin focus on pure aerospace lifts operating efficiency and order visibility

ai_view_en:
Signal is strong: a 16% EPS beat with ~25% revenue growth reflects booming commercial engine and high-margin aftermarket demand, with improved earnings quality after the pure-aerospace transition. Near-term the stock has solid support, though a 42x P/E embeds high expectations. Mid-term watch whether engine deliveries keep pace with demand, aftermarket margins and backlog. Track: commercial engine shipments and aftermarket revenue, operating margin, free cash flow, backlog and full-year guidance.

Watch：A 42.82x P/E is elevated, already pricing in aerospace optimism; Supply-chain and parts-delivery bottlenecks could cap output; Air-travel demand is sensitive to the macro economy and geopolitics
beat_or_miss: 超預期 / EPS超預期16.31%且營收年增24.74%，航太景氣強勁。
